csv_project_name: Engineering for Underground Storage Tanks Removal
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Muskogee, Oklahoma is seeking Request of Qualifications (RFQ) from qualified Engineering/Environmental Firms interested in providing professional services needed to design, specify, and oversee the removal of Underground Storage Tanks for the City's fuel station located at 301 S. Cherokee, Muskogee, OK 74403, that is no longer in use.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Underground Tank Design, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Hazardous Waste Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
title: Engineering for Underground Storage Tanks Removal
short_description: Engineering services for design and oversight of removing unused underground fuel storage tanks.
project_location: 301 S. Cherokee, Muskogee, OK 74403, Muskogee, Oklahoma, USA
project_scope: Professional services to design, specify, and oversee removal of underground storage tanks at the City's unused fuel station. The notice indicates environmental, hazardous waste, civil, mechanical, and underground tank design disciplines, but provides no technical quantities, tank sizes, or site dimensions.
services: Engineering and environmental professional services including design, specifications, and construction oversight for underground storage tank removal.
relevance_explanation:
- Project is for underground storage tank removal, not a bridge, building structure, roof, stadium, or special load-bearing structure.
- Scope is dominated by environmental, hazardous waste, and mechanical/civil support services.
- No indication of structural complexity, long spans, lightweight structures, or architecturally demanding engineering.
- Falls close to excluded categories such as environmental/feasibility-type services rather than sbp core structural design work.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Available information only indicates removal of underground storage tanks at an unused municipal fuel station; no tank count, capacity, contamination extent, demolition scope, or replacement works are provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible from the source alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because the notice is an RFQ for professional engineering/environmental services and lacks construction cost, scope quantities, and service level detail, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified engineering/environmental firms. Requested disciplines: architecture services, civil engineering, underground tank design, environmental engineering/planning/design, hazardous waste engineering, and mechanical engineering.
